title: confiture debug cte --format json
description: A CTE step-through session (CTEDebugSession.to_dict): each CTE of the query run in isolation, in order, stopping at the first that fails. A failing CTE is the query's finding, not confiture's error: the command exits 1 with this shape, `all_succeeded` false and `failed_at` naming the CTE. A missing --sql/--file or an unreachable database writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead. The `debug` group is experimental: its options and output may change in any release.

total_ctes.description: CTEs the query declares; `steps` may hold fewer when one failed.

all_succeeded.description: True when every step ran without error.

failed_at.description: The first CTE that failed, or null.

steps.description: One per CTE run, in the query's order.

rows.description: The rows fetched, each a list of values in column order.

execution_time_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the step, in whole milliseconds (truncated).

error.description: PostgreSQL's message when the step failed, else null.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
